high_level_description: A wide photograph of a lone hiker on a rocky alpine ridge at first light, with a sea of clouds filling the valley below.

style_description.aesthetics: expansive, serene, contemplative, golden hour warmth
style_description.lighting: soft pre-dawn light breaking from the right, low sun raking across the ridge, gentle atmospheric haze in the valley
style_description.photo: ultra-wide 24mm lens, f/8 deep focus, eye-level from behind, slight forward motion

compositional_deconstruction.background: A jagged alpine ridge silhouetted against a pale orange and lavender sky. Below the ridge a thick sea of clouds fills the valley, with two distant peaks breaking through on the left. Soft volumetric haze catches the first light.

elements.desc: A lone hiker with a small backpack walking along the ridge, back to camera, right foot mid-step, small dark silhouette against the bright sky and cloud sea.
A wide foreground of dark weathered rocks and low alpine grass filling the lower third, leading the eye toward the hiker in the middle distance.
